contractTypes.subtitle: The four employment contract types defined by the 2019 Labour Code.
contractTypes.label: Contract type
contractTypes.fixedByLawTitle: This list is set by law and cannot be configured
contractTypes.fixedByLaw: Employment contract types are defined by the 2019 Labour Code, and each one carries different obligations for social insurance, probation length and termination notice. The system therefore does not allow adding, editing or deleting them. The seasonal contract was abolished by the 2019 code and is kept only so historical data stays readable.
contractTypes.loadError: Could not load the contract type list.

leaveTypes.subtitle: Leave categories, the yearly entitlement and the policy that applies to each.
leaveTypes.name: Leave type
leaveTypes.daysPerYearHint: Enter 0 when there is no fixed entitlement (e.g. unpaid leave, time off in lieu).
leaveTypes.minDaysHint: The smallest bookable unit, usually 0.5 days (half a day).
leaveTypes.maxConsecutiveHint: Leave empty for no limit on consecutive days.
leaveTypes.advanceNoticeHint: Enter 0 when no notice is required (e.g. sick leave, bereavement).
leaveTypes.descriptionHint: Cite the article that applies, e.g. "Article 113, Labour Code 2019".
leaveTypes.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Article 113 Labour Code 2019 – 12 working days per year
leaveTypes.statusHint: A leave type that already has requests against it cannot be deleted — set it to Inactive instead.

holidays.name: Holiday name
